protocol.classification: prespecified toy development experiment, not confirmation
protocol.selection: initialization minimum mean training loss; no later selection or rejection
protocol.freshness: distinct deterministic seeds per phase and generation, exposed after execution
protocol.budget: every arm receives the same eight meta-objective evaluations per generation; unused evaluations are explicitly charged waste; random displacement norm matches self displacement from that arm's own parent
protocol.claim: separate exact reconstruction, self-application, and fresh-target utility; do not infer RSI or AGI
